sloka: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहुः कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः ।वायसे कृतवान् क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वरः ।। ५.३८.२९।।।।
transliteration: tatastasmin mahābāhuḥ kopasaṁvartitekṣaṇaḥ ।vāyase kṛtavān krūrāṁ matiṁ matimatāṁ varaḥ ।। 5.38.29।।।।

translations.english: 'Then you, the strongarmed and best among the wise, your eyeballs rolling in fury, made up your mind about the cruel crow.
